timestamp.description: Unix timestamp in seconds: at a height, the block's header time (not guaranteed to increase between heights); at a calendar period, its UTC start; at a halving or difficulty epoch, its first block's header time.

price_close.description:
Closing price: the price at the end of each period.

Separate open, high, low, and close views of Bitview's block-level BTC/USD price series for each supported time period. Heights before 340,000 use baked historical exchange prices; later heights use an on-chain oracle that estimates price from round-USD transaction-output patterns. Zero before the first exchange price (block 74,641, August 2010). Closing price for each supported period. A populated period uses its final block-level price; an empty period carries the previous close. Reported in USD per BTC.

market_cap.description:
Supply: the bitcoin held. Its market value: valued at the price of the day.

Uses all UTXOs. Total unspent supply. Reported in US dollars: the amount at the spot price (its market cap), zero before the first exchange price (block 74,641, August 2010).

difficulty.description:
Difficulty: how hard it is to find a block, adjusted every 2,016 blocks to keep them ten minutes apart.

Mining difficulty encoded by the block header: Bitcoin's maximum target divided by the block's proof-of-work target.

difficulty_adjustment.description:
Difficulty change: how much difficulty moved over the last 2,016 blocks.

Relative difficulty change versus 2,016 block heights earlier: represented-block difficulty divided by lookback difficulty, minus one. Positive values mean difficulty increased and negative values mean it decreased. Unavailable for the first 2,016 blocks. As a percentage.

hashrate.description:
Hash rate: the computing power securing Bitcoin, estimated from how fast blocks are found.

Network hash-rate estimates derived from block production. The base estimate sums each block's difficulty-implied hash rate (the work it proved per ten-minute target) over the trailing 24 hours and divides by the 144 blocks expected at Bitcoin's ten-minute target, so a window spanning a difficulty adjustment weighs each block by its own difficulty. Network hash-rate estimate for the represented block, in hashes per second.

realized_price.description:
Realized price: what holders paid for their bitcoin, on average, each coin at the price it last moved at.

Uses all UTXOs. Creation prices (spot when each output was created) of the cohort's unspent outputs, weighted by satoshis. Realized price: realized cap divided by supply, the weighted mean; undefined (null) while the cohort holds no supply. Reported in USD per BTC.

realized_cap.description:
Realized cap: what holders paid for their bitcoin, in all, each coin at the price it last moved at.

Uses all UTXOs. Realized cap: the sum of each unspent output's BTC value times the spot price when it was created. Reported in US dollars.

sth_realized_price.description:
Short-term holders: coins that moved within the last 150 days. Realized price: what holders paid for their bitcoin, on average, each coin at the price it last moved at.

Uses short-term-holder UTXOs younger than 150 days. Creation prices (spot when each output was created) of the cohort's unspent outputs, weighted by satoshis. Realized price: realized cap divided by supply, the weighted mean; undefined (null) while the cohort holds no supply. Reported in USD per BTC.

lth_realized_price.description:
Long-term holders: coins unmoved for 150 days or more. Realized price: what holders paid for their bitcoin, on average, each coin at the price it last moved at.

Uses long-term-holder UTXOs at least 150 days old. Creation prices (spot when each output was created) of the cohort's unspent outputs, weighted by satoshis. Realized price: realized cap divided by supply, the weighted mean; undefined (null) while the cohort holds no supply. Reported in USD per BTC.

circulating_supply.description:
Circulating supply: all the bitcoin in existence, unspent.

Value of all unspent transaction outputs after the represented block, close to Bitcoin Core's `gettxoutsetinfo` `total_amount`: `OP_RETURN` outputs are left out, but outputs with scripts over 10,000 bytes, which Core also leaves out as unspendable, are counted. Reported in BTC; one BTC equals 100,000,000 satoshis.

sth_supply.description:
Short-term holders: coins that moved within the last 150 days. Supply: the bitcoin held.

Uses short-term-holder UTXOs younger than 150 days. Total unspent supply. Reported in BTC; one BTC equals 100,000,000 satoshis.

lth_supply.description:
Long-term holders: coins unmoved for 150 days or more. Supply: the bitcoin held.

Uses long-term-holder UTXOs at least 150 days old. Total unspent supply. Reported in BTC; one BTC equals 100,000,000 satoshis.

velocity_usd.description:
Velocity, in dollars: how many times the market cap changed hands over the past year.

Trailing 365-day transfer volume valued in US dollars divided by the all-chain market capitalization at the represented block; undefined (null) when market capitalization is zero.

inflation_rate.description:
Inflation rate: the new bitcoin a year brings, against the supply.

Scheduled annual issuance over the circulating supply: the represented block's scheduled subsidy times 52,560 blocks, divided by the supply. Null without supply (block 0, whose output is unspendable). As a percentage.

subsidy_sum_24h_usd.description:
Block subsidy: the new bitcoin miners claimed, besides fees.

Coinbase output value minus the block's total transaction fees, floored at zero. This is a derived subsidy component, not the scheduled consensus subsidy, and can be lower when the miner leaves some available reward unclaimed. Total of the per-block values over the trailing window ending at the represented block. At time-period indexes, the value is taken at the period's final block. Uses a trailing 24-hour window. Reported in US dollars, each block's amount valued at that block's spot price (zero before the first exchange price, block 74,641). Undefined (null) until the window lies at or after the first exchange price (block 74,641): blocks before it are valued at zero.

subsidy_sum_1y_usd.description:
Block subsidy: the new bitcoin miners claimed, besides fees.

Coinbase output value minus the block's total transaction fees, floored at zero. This is a derived subsidy component, not the scheduled consensus subsidy, and can be lower when the miner leaves some available reward unclaimed. Total of the per-block values over the trailing window ending at the represented block. At time-period indexes, the value is taken at the period's final block. Uses a trailing 365-day window. Reported in US dollars, each block's amount valued at that block's spot price (zero before the first exchange price, block 74,641). Undefined (null) until the window lies at or after the first exchange price (block 74,641): blocks before it are valued at zero.

liveliness.description:
Liveliness: how much of all coins' holding time has been spent, rising when old coins move.

Cointime measures how long bitcoin remains unspent. One coinblock is one BTC held for one block interval; spending destroys the coinblocks that the spent outputs accumulated. Liveliness: cumulative coinblocks destroyed divided by cumulative coinblocks created. A value nearer one means more of the holding time accumulated by the supply has been consumed by spending; a value nearer zero means more remains stored in unspent outputs. Undefined (null) while cumulative coinblocks created is zero (block 0). As a ratio.

supply_in_profit.description:
Supply in profit: coins whose price now is at or above the one they last moved at.

Uses all UTXOs. Supply in profit: creation price at or below the spot price. Reported in BTC; one BTC equals 100,000,000 satoshis.

supply_in_loss.description:
Supply in loss: coins whose price now is below the one they last moved at.

Uses all UTXOs. Supply in loss: creation price above the spot price. Reported in BTC; one BTC equals 100,000,000 satoshis.

sopr_24h.description:
SOPR (spent output profit ratio): what coins sold for against what they cost. Above 1, sellers take profits; below 1, they sell at a loss.

Uses all UTXOs. Spent output profit ratio (SOPR): spend-time value in US dollars of the outputs spent over the window divided by their creation-time value (value destroyed); undefined (null) when that value is zero. Uses a trailing 24-hour window.

active_address_count_avg_24h.description:
Active addresses: how many sent or received in each block.

Arithmetic mean of the per-block values over the trailing window ending at the represented block; each block has equal weight. At time-period indexes, the value is taken at the period's final block. Uses a trailing 24-hour window.

coinbase_cumulative.description:
Miner revenue: what miners were paid, new coins and fees together.

Sum of the output values of the block's coinbase transaction. This is the miner reward actually assigned to coinbase outputs, not the total reward available. Cumulative value through the represented block. At time-period indexes, the value is taken at the period's final block. Reported in BTC; one BTC equals 100,000,000 satoshis.

coinbase_cumulative_usd.description:
Miner revenue: what miners were paid, new coins and fees together.

Sum of the output values of the block's coinbase transaction. This is the miner reward actually assigned to coinbase outputs, not the total reward available. Cumulative value through the represented block. At time-period indexes, the value is taken at the period's final block. Reported in US dollars, each block's amount valued at that block's spot price (zero before the first exchange price, block 74,641).

subsidy_cumulative.description:
Block subsidy: the new bitcoin miners claimed, besides fees.

Coinbase output value minus the block's total transaction fees, floored at zero. This is a derived subsidy component, not the scheduled consensus subsidy, and can be lower when the miner leaves some available reward unclaimed. Cumulative value through the represented block. At time-period indexes, the value is taken at the period's final block. Reported in BTC; one BTC equals 100,000,000 satoshis.

fees_cumulative.description:
Fees: what transactions paid miners.

Sum of input value minus output value across the block's non-coinbase transactions. Cumulative value through the represented block. At time-period indexes, the value is taken at the period's final block. Reported in BTC; one BTC equals 100,000,000 satoshis.

fees_cumulative_usd.description:
Fees: what transactions paid miners.

Sum of input value minus output value across the block's non-coinbase transactions. Cumulative value through the represented block. At time-period indexes, the value is taken at the period's final block. Reported in US dollars, each block's amount valued at that block's spot price (zero before the first exchange price, block 74,641).

tx_count_cumulative.description:
Transactions: how many were confirmed.

Number of transactions, including the coinbase transaction. Cumulative value through the represented block. At time-period indexes, the value is taken at the period's final block.

transfer_volume_cumulative_usd.description:
Transfer volume: the bitcoin transactions moved, change included.

Sum of the input values of non-coinbase transactions. This equals their total output value plus transaction fees and is not adjusted to estimate economic payment volume. Cumulative value through the represented block. At time-period indexes, the value is taken at the period's final block. Reported in US dollars, each block's amount valued at that block's spot price (zero before the first exchange price, block 74,641).

coindays_destroyed_cumulative.description:
Coin days destroyed (CDD): coins spent, each times the days it was held, so old coins moving count most.

Uses all UTXOs. Coin days destroyed (CDD): spent coin amounts multiplied by their age in fractional days. Cumulative value through the represented block. At time-period indexes, the value is taken at the period's final block.

realized_profit_cumulative.description:
Realized profit: what sellers gained over what their coins cost.

Uses all UTXOs. Profit realized by the cohort's outputs: spending value minus creation-date value, counted only for profitable spends. Cumulative value through the represented block. At time-period indexes, the value is taken at the period's final block. Reported in US dollars.

realized_loss_cumulative.description:
Realized loss: what sellers lost against what their coins cost.

Uses all UTXOs. Loss realized by the cohort's outputs: creation-date value minus spending value, counted only for losing spends. Cumulative value through the represented block. At time-period indexes, the value is taken at the period's final block. Reported in US dollars.

lth_realized_profit_cumulative.description:
